tei:div.tei:p: (101)na mo gu ru/ gnubs kyi rigs 'khrungs bka' babs gnyis pa'i bdag chung ngur rab byung bal po'i rgyal po mnyes/ rgyal bal mkhas pa mi bzhes rjes su bzung*/ dbang gi chu bo rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ ba su dha rar rgyud dang man ngag dang*/ che btsan skyes las spyi mod dgongs 'dus dang*/ gnyag las sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs ma lus pa'i/ rgyud kyi dkyus bshad rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ dka' ba spyad pas rgya gar lan bdun phyin/ phyag rdor rjes bzung sangs rgyas ye shes gsol/ dbang rtags 'gyur med gser gyi rdo rje byin/ snyan brgyud chu bo rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ dur khrod mtsho gling mi min drag po'i gnas/ bsgrub pas yi dam lha tshogs dpag med dang*/ khyad par 'jam dpal khros pa'i dngos grub brnyes/ drag sngags chu bo rjogs la gsol ba 'debs/ thugs kyi dben gnas bsgrags kyi yongs rjogs (102)mthil/ sems nyid skye shi med pa'i don gzigs pas/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ grub pa'i dbang po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ khong log byung bas dkar po'i che ba bton/ drag sngags rnon pos ma rung tshar bcad cing*/ slar yang lha srin bskul bas zhing bcu brlag mthu chen yongs grags khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa rin po che'i/ mdo rgyu sems gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng*/ 'od 'phro'i sa yi rtogs pa mngon du mjad/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bdag nyid kyi/ rgyud la mgon po khyod kyi ye shes kyi/ gzigs pa dam pa nam yang mi dman pas/ byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung du gsol/
bu nag ris kyi ngor ngag ming pas 'phral bris dge'o/// /
